protocol.scope: Independent fictional bounded development; no production qualification or final credit
protocol.dictionary: blank0 + printableASCII U32..126 indices1..95 (space1) + UNK96; rows copied from original official dictionary
protocol.preprocessing: All RGB!=255 whole-line bbox +2originalpx, no whitening/threshold/per-glyph crop; retain every original nonwhite sample/shared baseline/relative heights/internal gaps. Production BGR48 original-center bilinear uint8 round norm0padding width320..960.
protocol.rendering: font16..32logicalpx density2/4, common baseline, black/navy/gray/green; 10percent mild Gaussian blur, no JPEG; paired case/confusable strings use same rendering seed/font; framing all nonwhite after degradation

training.featurePolicy: CNN weights and all BN fixed/eval; original SVTR encoder trainable lowLR; original copied head trainable; full-vocabulary frozen teacher projected by exact sum of excluded probabilities into UNK for KL. Negatives target UNK, never lost full text.

protocol.acceptance: Experimental only: nonempty printableASCII/noUNK, emitted minconfidence>=.8, rejectProbability<=.05 for trained models, and every CTC interval within validWidth. Baselines without trained reject use original same minconfidence/domain/padding gates. Native/full-source proof remains mandatory independently.
protocol.selection: Include original full18710 base. A trained checkpoint may replace it only if positive exact>=original, incorrectAccepted<=original, negativeAccepted<=original. Eligible maximum correctAccepted, then exact, lower wrongAccepted, lower negativeAccepted, lower CER, earlier epoch; baseline wins exact ties. Reduced untrained baseline is diagnostic only, no probability inflation credit. No final opening unless development is promising and fixed model/conditions are frozen.
protocol.final: Sawarabi Gothic/Mincho reserved, not rendered or inferred in this bounded stage; separate final protocol required if promising
protocol.exclusion: Exact prior literals from official comparison oracle, PP manifests, scratch ASCII manifests, parent physical-frame-fresh-development oracle and existing repo research JSONs; exclusion only, never copied as targets. New train/dev mutually disjoint. No school originals.
protocol.sourceProofProbes: Separate unscored pixel-alias and lost-whole-prefix contradiction probes; identical recognizer pixels with incompatible source/script provenance cannot be resolved by crop classifier. Never train on these contradictory targets.
protocol.portability: If promising standard ONNX + BGR48/dictionary/reject/source metadata later; optional CoreML conversion without iOS edit or iPhone eligibility claim

fontPriorExposure: Train fonts previously used. Dev KiwiMaru/HinaMincho parent confirmed unconsumed; ZenMaru previously consumed and downloaded only here, NOT used in new dev. Final Sawarabi reserved untouched.
